records.claim: Drugs that affect glucose metabolism : Adjustment of SOLIQUA 100/33 dosage may be needed; closely monitor blood glucose. ( 7.1 ) Antiadrenergic Drugs (e.g., beta-blockers, clonidine, guanethidine, and reserpine): Hypoglycemia signs and symptoms may be reduced. ( 7.1 ) Effects of delayed gastric emptying on oral medications : Lixisenatide delays gastric emptying which may impact absorption of concomitantly administered oral medications.
